text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- About 90 percent of Portuguese companies have declared losses, relieving them of a tax burden.
- Chrysler is considering purchasing the "Sodia" car factory in Setubal, south of Lisbon, which is producing Renault Clio cars until 1998.
- Excess capacity in the Spanish milk industry is leading producers to sell milk to Portuguese retailers at below cost price and has provoked accusations of dumping.

- AutoEuropa, a Ford/Volkswagen car plant in Palmela, south of Lisbon, will increase its production from 515 units to 677 vehicles a day, due to improving demand from international markets, said managing director Ralph Rosignolo.
- Costa Leal, chairman of Montepio Geral, told the paper that the bank, through insurance company Lusitania, wants to buy a stake of at least 51 percent in insurance company "O Trabalho".
